trans-unit.source: We've done it! We've saved Yggdrasill!
trans-unit.target: We've done it! We've saved Yggdrasill!

trans-unit.source: It's all thanks to the unicorn, isn't it?

trans-unit.source: Yes, absolutely. How can we express our gratitude to it...?

trans-unit.source: Okay, now it's my turn! Let's sail to the ancient city of Thor, shall we?
